requirements.text: Six requirements govern this change. Each original declaration gets exactly one owner, with all six public Update exports retained, including record selectors and instances, proven by a before-and-after declaration map, an unchanged export list, and compiled original callers.

Ordered request lookup, speculative proofs, state continuation, fee input and upper slot are kept, shown by focused fold controls and a fresh-blueprint end-to-end journey through production entry points.

Duty results and refusals are kept: mint quantities, approval returns, holder selection, destination datums, custody spends and refunds, owner deposit settlement, and no required signer — shown by the existing booking, burn-source and lifecycle assertions plus a behavior-sensitive negative control.
Transaction assembly, balancing and script and reference use stay at the same public call path, shown by the component build, the focused cage suite, the fresh-blueprint journey and exact-head CI.

Contributor-facing ownership, dependency and fold-flow documentation is published with source and API links and speech, passing the presentation checks and source-derived review. And independent evidence derivation and Conformance state stay untouched: unchanged consumer compilation and listing, and no new coverage claim.

boundary.text: The boundary. The deposit and custody settlement code, the shared-custody case and the model exit obligations are intake facts, not rules to reinterpret. One set of tests is outside this scope. No Lean, on-chain, wire, validator, Conformance, workflow, dependency, executable-name, release or deployment edit belongs to this ticket; a needed excluded-surface change is a question to the epic owner before any edit. A clear code-versus-Lean contradiction is repaired within scope with evidence, while ambiguity or a model conflict holds the affected acceptance.

Source inspection and a passing build alone do not establish transaction correspondence: the exact candidate, model, gate receipts, negative control, independent audit and uncovered behavior stay explicit in the pull-request record.
